# Packages whose tests run on the windows-latest job (.github/workflows/windows.yml).
# One package per line; '#' starts a comment. No wildcards ("./...").
# NEVER ./pkg/hub or a ./pkg/hub/... package: the unsharded pkg/hub test
# compile needs about 12 GiB (the job fails if such a line appears).
# A package left off for a Windows-environment reason gets a one-line reason
# here; nothing is skipped.
./pkg/util/privatefs
./pkg/util/pathcanon
./pkg/util/filelock
./pkg/tunnelclient
./pkg/credentials
./pkg/apiclient
# ./pkg/config: anchored to the Windows site tests of rows C3-C11 (the full
# suite is POSIX-bound, follow-up D4).
./pkg/config -run=^(TestWindowsAtomicWrite_PrivateReplacesTooOpenInheritInherits|TestWindowsAtomicWrite_PrivateReplacesSymlinkNotTarget|TestWindowsPersistHubID_GlobalDirAndFilePrivate|TestWindowsSettingsLock_RefusesJunctionLockFile|TestWindowsUpdateCLIContext_Private|TestWindowsIntegrationConfig_Private|TestWindowsCurrentUserOwns|TestWindowsMigrateLegacyGlobalLayout_SkipsForeignOwnedEntry|TestWindowsMkdirLikeLegacyRoot_FollowsSourceACL|TestWindowsWriteConflictBackup_Private|TestWindowsCopySettingsBackup_FollowsSourceACL|TestWindowsCopySettingsBackup_DecisionFromReadHandle|TestWindowsProtectionForCheck_FailsClosed|TestWriteConflictBackup_PartialFileRemovedOnFailure)$
# ./pkg/brokercredentials: the Windows-reachable read (the write path and
# multistore are gated).
./pkg/brokercredentials -run=^(TestWindowsBrokerCredentials_RefusesUsersReadableFile|TestWindowsBrokerCredentials_RefusesSymlink|TestWindowsBrokerCredentials_MissingIsNotFound|TestStore_Load|TestStore_LoadNotFound|TestStore_LoadValidation)$
# ./pkg/agent: row X3 only (the rest is gated agent provisioning).
./pkg/agent -run=^(TestWindowsResolutionCache_NewDirAndFilePrivate|TestWindowsResolutionCache_RepairsOwnedTooOpenFile|TestWindowsResolutionCache_ForeignOwnedFileWarnedNotRepaired|TestWindowsResolutionCache_TooOpenDirWarnedNotRepaired)$
./pkg/hubprofile
# ./cmd: anchored to the Windows-relevant tests (design §5.2; the full
# suite is POSIX-bound, follow-up D4). Never the attachment-writing
# message tests.
./cmd -run=^(TestSSHWrite_NewFilePrivate|TestSSHWrite_FollowsUserSymlinkAndRepairsOpenTarget|TestSSHWrite_RefusesForeignWritableParent|TestSSHWrite_RefusesForeignOwnedTarget|TestSSHWrite_RefusesHardLinkedTarget|TestSSHKnownHostsTempFilePrivate|TestSSHShellQuoteForCmd|TestVSCodeFiles_PrivateOnWindows|TestLockVSCodeDir_TimesOut|TestLockVSCodeDir_WaitsForRelease|TestLockVSCodeDir_DefaultWait|TestHubTestIdentityOut_DescribesACL|TestResolveBrokerJoinToken_WarnsOnForeignACE|TestWindowsGate_RefusesServerAndBroker|TestWindowsGate_DropsFlagValidationOnGatedCommands|TestWindowsGate_RefusesBeforeProjectResolution|TestWindowsGate_HidesOnlyGatedCommands|TestWindowsGate_AllowlistEntriesExist|TestWindowsGate_NoopOnUnix)$
